summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SFTP Data Pipeline Monitor feature (Iteration 6). All backend APIs working correctly (13/13 tests passed). Frontend UI fully functional with Demo Mode badge, KPI cards, charts, data source cards, store SLA tracker, processing logs table with filters, and SFTP configuration panel. All 9 pages load successfully including new /sftp-monitor route.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/sftp/status returns demo_mode: true, scheduler status, connection info
Backend: GET /api/admin/sftp/config returns saved configuration
Backend: POST /api/admin/sftp/config saves SFTP configuration
Backend: GET /api/admin/sftp/stats returns total, success_rate, by_type (3 types), trend (7 days), stores_uploaded_today
Backend: GET /api/admin/sftp/logs returns array of log records with filename, file_type, status, rows_processed
Backend: GET /api/admin/sftp/logs with status and file_type filters works correctly
Backend: POST /api/admin/sftp/seed-demo seeds 7 days of demo data (~154 records)
Backend: POST /api/admin/sftp/trigger runs one demo processing cycle (22 files)
Backend: POST /api/admin/sftp/retry-failed retries recently failed files
Backend: POST /api/admin/sftp/scheduler/start starts the scheduler
Backend: POST /api/admin/sftp/scheduler/stop stops the scheduler
Backend: POST /api/admin/sftp/test-connection returns demo status in demo mode
Frontend: SFTP Monitor page (/sftp-monitor) loads with data-testid='sftp-monitor-page'
Frontend: Demo Mode badge visible with data-testid='demo-mode-badge'
Frontend: 5 KPI cards visible (Total Files, Success Rate, Records Processed, Failed Files, Stores Today)
Frontend: Processing Trend line chart with Success/Failed lines over 7 days
Frontend: Records by Data Source bar chart with 3 data types
Frontend: 3 Data Source cards (Daily Sales, Store Inventory, WH Inventory) with success rates
Frontend: Store Upload SLA section shows 10 stores (ST001-ST010) with green badges
Frontend: Processing Logs table with type and status filter dropdowns
Frontend: Configure button shows SFTP config form (host, port, username, etc.)
Frontend: Manual Trigger, Refresh, Seed Demo Data buttons work
Frontend: Scheduler Start/Stop toggle works
Frontend: Sidebar has SFTP Monitor link
Frontend: All 9 pages load successfully (/, /upload, /config, /core-logics, /gap-analysis, /bi-dashboards, /warehouse, /sftp-monitor, /chatbot)

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All UI components render correctly, all 9 pages load

seed_data_creation: Demo data seeded via POST /api/admin/sftp/seed-demo - 154 records across 7 days, 10 stores (ST001-ST010), 2 warehouses (WH001-WH002), 3 file types (daily_sales, store_inventory, warehouse_inventory). Success rate ~92%.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SFTP Monitor feature fully implemented with demo mode. Backend runs on port 8001, frontend on 3000. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://zip-improved.preview.emergentagent.com. SFTP connection is MOCKED/demo mode - generates simulated processing logs instead of connecting to real SFTP server. Charts use Chart.js. SFTP config stored in MongoDB 'sftp_config' collection, logs in 'sftp_logs' collection. All 7 CSV data files are uploaded from previous sessions.

mocked_apis_list: SFTP connection (demo mode - generates simulated processing logs instead of connecting to real SFTP server)
